messages.author: Kirsten Sørensen
messages.text: Kwame is on approved leave Thursday and Friday. Rohan has the Pellworth dispatcher training Thursday morning — booked, not movable.

messages.author: Bronwyn Hale
messages.text: The rehearsal is one continuous session; do not split it across days. An evening extension would be Kirsten's call, and nobody has asked her.

messages.author: Rohan Desai
messages.text: I am free Thursday afternoon, but that is four hours, not seven.
